name: Sweat As Lube
source:
Your friend invited you to the gym. It's your first time. You've never worked out in your life beyond stocking shelves. You're just here to try it out and fit.

[From [url=https://ventkazemaru.itch.io/sweat-as-lube]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的朋友邀请你去健身房。这是你第一次。除了在架子上买东西之外，你一生中从未做过任何锻炼。你来这里只是为了尝试并适应。

[来自[url=https://ventkazemaru.itch.io/sweat-as-lube]itch.io[/url]]
